_note: Schreibwerkstatt (Lernplattform 3.0 P47, KI-Tutor T6): 12 Wochen-Mail-Situationen, je Kapitel mindestens eine (Kapitel 1 bis 7). Pro Situation: Anlass (brief, Englisch ist der Arbeitsauftrag, Deutsch die Hilfe), Gegenüber (to), Situationsart (sit, passend zu den Auswahlwerten von „Mein Arbeitsalltag“), 3 Kapitelmuster mit einem lokalen Erkennungsmuster (re, ohne Beachtung der Schreibweise; ex muss passen, no darf nicht passen: tests/unit/c1Mail.test.ts) und 4 Wendungen. Erkennung ist nur die lokale Anzeige beim Tippen; ob ein Muster richtig benutzt wurde, urteilt Claude (used). Lehrer-Prüfung: Selbstprüf-Liste im Bericht von P47.

brief.en: Your steering committee meets on Friday. Write a short status update on the migration of the customer archive: what has been done since the kickoff, what your team is working on this week, and what your team had already completed before the audit started.
brief.de: Der Lenkungskreis tagt am Freitag. Schreib ein kurzes Status-Update zur Migration des Kundenarchivs: was seit dem Kickoff erledigt ist, woran dein Team diese Woche arbeitet und was dein Team schon erledigt hatte, bevor das Audit begann.

patterns.ex: We have processed 1.2 million invoices since March.
patterns.no: We processed 1.2 million invoices last March.

patterns.ex: Right now we are testing the new workflow.
patterns.no: We tested the new workflow in May.

patterns.ex: We had already migrated the legacy data before the audit started.
patterns.no: We had a long meeting about the data.

brief.en: A key client asks why onboarding has taken longer than planned. Write a reply that explains what has been happening since go-live, how long your team has been working on the open issues, and what you had already fixed before the client wrote.
brief.de: Ein wichtiger Kunde fragt, warum das Onboarding länger dauert als geplant. Schreib eine Antwort: was seit dem Go-live passiert ist, wie lange dein Team schon an den offenen Punkten arbeitet und was du schon behoben hattest, bevor der Kunde schrieb.

patterns.ex: My team has been working on the access issue since Monday.
patterns.no: My team worked on the access issue on Monday.

patterns.ex: We had already fixed the login error when your message arrived.
patterns.no: We had a call with your team.

patterns.ex: We have resolved nine of twelve tickets so far.
patterns.no: We resolved nine tickets yesterday.

brief.en: Your CFO wants to know when the new invoicing system will be ready. Write an email with the timeline: what will be finished by the time the audit starts, what will still be in progress next month, and the deadline you commit to.
brief.de: Dein Finanzchef will wissen, wann das neue Rechnungssystem fertig ist. Schreib eine Mail mit dem Zeitplan: was bis zum Audit fertig sein wird, was nächsten Monat noch läuft und auf welchen Termin du dich festlegst.

patterns.ex: By the time the audit starts, we will have tested every interface.
patterns.no: The audit starts in March.

patterns.ex: We will have migrated the archive by then.
patterns.no: We will start the migration next week.

patterns.ex: We commit to going live no later than November 30.
patterns.no: We commit to going live in November.

brief.en: Invite the IT lead of a client to a workshop next week. Say what you will be doing during the session, what you were originally going to cover and why the plan changed, and what you need from them once the access list is ready.
brief.de: Lade die IT-Leitung eines Kunden zu einem Workshop nächste Woche ein. Sag, was du während der Sitzung machen wirst, was du ursprünglich behandeln wolltest und warum sich der Plan geändert hat, und was du von ihnen brauchst, sobald die Zugriffsliste fertig ist.

patterns.ex: I will be presenting the new interface at ten.
patterns.no: I will present the new interface at ten.

patterns.ex: We were going to cover reporting first, but the plan changed.
patterns.no: We are going to cover reporting first.

patterns.ex: Once you send the access list, we can start the setup.
patterns.no: Please send the access list.

phrases: to be on the safe side

brief.en: A client asks for a 20 percent discount on the contract renewal. Write a reply that offers what you can and under which conditions, politely declines the rest, keeps the door open, and says what would be possible if they committed to a longer term.
brief.de: Ein Kunde bittet um 20 Prozent Rabatt auf die Vertragsverlängerung. Schreib eine Antwort: was du anbieten kannst und unter welchen Bedingungen; lehn den Rest höflich ab, halte die Tür offen und sag, was möglich wäre, wenn er sich länger bindet.

patterns.ex: We can offer ten percent as long as you renew for three years.
patterns.no: We can offer ten percent for a three-year renewal.

patterns.ex: If we extended the term, we would be able to lower the price.
patterns.no: If you renew, we will lower the price.

patterns.ex: Would it be possible to move the signing date to June?
patterns.no: Please move the signing date to June.

brief.en: Your pilot project missed its goals. Write a short lessons-learned email to your manager: what you wish the team had done differently, what would have happened with another month of testing, and what would be different today if the team had started earlier.
brief.de: Dein Pilotprojekt hat die Ziele verfehlt. Schreib deiner Chefin oder deinem Chef eine kurze Lessons-Learned-Mail: was du dir anders gewünscht hättest, was mit einem weiteren Testmonat passiert wäre und was heute anders wäre, wenn das Team früher begonnen hätte.

patterns.ex: I wish we had involved the IT team earlier.
patterns.no: I wish you a good week.

patterns.ex: We would have caught the error with another month of testing.
patterns.no: We would catch the error with more testing.

patterns.ex: If we had started in January, we would be live today.
patterns.no: If we start in January, we will be live in June.

brief.en: A short outage affected several customers yesterday. Write an incident summary for management: what has been done so far, what is believed to have caused it, and what you recommend.
brief.de: Gestern hat ein kurzer Ausfall mehrere Kunden betroffen. Schreib eine Störungszusammenfassung für die Geschäftsleitung: was bisher getan wurde, was vermutlich die Ursache ist und was du empfiehlst.

patterns.ex: The affected servers have been restarted.
patterns.no: We restarted the affected servers.

patterns.ex: The outage is believed to have been caused by a faulty update.
patterns.no: A faulty update caused the outage.

patterns.ex: I recommend testing every update first.
patterns.no: We test every update first.

brief.en: A colleague missed the budget meeting. Summarize it for them: what people said, what they wanted to know, and what someone insisted on or recommended for the next quarter.
brief.de: Ein Kollege hat das Budgetmeeting verpasst. Fass es für ihn zusammen: was gesagt wurde, was die Leute wissen wollten und was jemand für das nächste Quartal verlangt oder empfohlen hat.

patterns.ex: The CFO said that the budget had already been approved.
patterns.no: The CFO approved the budget.

patterns.re: \b(?:asked|wondered|wanted to know|could you tell me|do you know|I wonder)\s+(?:if|whether|what|when|where|why|how|who|which)\b
patterns.ex: Marketing asked when the new tool would be available.
patterns.no: Marketing asked for the new tool.

patterns.ex: Finance insisted that every request be approved in writing.
patterns.no: Finance insisted on written approval.

brief.en: Your vendor may miss the delivery date. Write a careful risk assessment for your CFO: how likely a delay is, what it might be worth doing now, and what you would lean toward.
brief.de: Dein Lieferant verpasst vielleicht den Liefertermin. Schreib deinem Finanzchef eine vorsichtige Risikoeinschätzung: wie wahrscheinlich eine Verzögerung ist, was sich jetzt lohnen könnte und wozu du neigst.

patterns.ex: A delay of two weeks is highly likely.
patterns.no: A delay of two weeks is possible.

patterns.ex: It might be worth asking for a written commitment.
patterns.no: It is worth asking for a written commitment.

patterns.ex: I would be inclined to plan with a buffer of two weeks.
patterns.no: I would plan with a buffer of two weeks.

brief.en: Procurement asked you to compare two suppliers. Write a short recommendation: contrast the two offers, name a weakness you accept, and close by saying what you are looking forward to.
brief.de: Der Einkauf hat dich gebeten, zwei Lieferanten zu vergleichen. Schreib eine kurze Empfehlung: Gegenüberstellung der beiden Angebote, eine Schwäche, die du in Kauf nimmst, und zum Schluss, worauf du dich freust.

patterns.ex: Supplier A is cheaper, whereas supplier B offers faster delivery.
patterns.no: Supplier A is cheaper and supplier B is faster.

patterns.ex: Despite the higher price, I recommend supplier B.
patterns.no: Although the price is higher, I recommend supplier B.

patterns.ex: I look forward to working with the new team.
patterns.no: I look forward to your answer.

brief.en: Write a crisp quarterly update to an investor. Stress the single most important result, acknowledge one weakness without sounding defensive, and say what happens next.
brief.de: Schreib einem Investor ein knappes Quartals-Update. Betone das eine wichtigste Ergebnis, räum eine Schwäche ein, ohne defensiv zu klingen, und sag, was als Nächstes passiert.

patterns.ex: What matters most is that renewals grew by 12 percent.
patterns.no: Renewals grew by 12 percent, which matters most.

patterns.ex: It was the new pricing model that drove the growth.
patterns.no: The new pricing model drove the growth.

patterns.ex: That said, our costs rose faster than planned.
patterns.no: But our costs rose faster than planned.

brief.en: A client has escalated a delayed delivery to your director. Write the reply: apologize briefly, show what you did after hearing about it, show that you genuinely understand the frustration, and come back to the original commitment.
brief.de: Ein Kunde hat eine verspätete Lieferung an deine Direktorin eskaliert. Schreib die Antwort: entschuldige dich kurz, zeig, was du nach der Nachricht getan hast, zeig, dass du den Ärger wirklich nachvollziehen kannst, und komm auf die ursprüngliche Zusage zurück.

patterns.ex: Having reviewed the shipment log, I found the delay.
patterns.no: I reviewed the shipment log and found the delay.

patterns.ex: I do understand how frustrating this is.
patterns.no: I understand how frustrating this is.

patterns.ex: Coming back to our original commitment: we will deliver by Friday.
patterns.no: We will deliver by Friday.
